2665: def _cleanup_mobile_pairings() -> None:
2666:     now = time.time()
2667:     for token, expires_at in list(MOBILE_PAIRINGS.items()):
2668:         if expires_at <= now:
2669:             MOBILE_PAIRINGS.pop(token, None)
2670: 
2671: 
2672: def _mobile_device_hash(token: str) -> str:
2673:     return hashlib.sha256(str(token or "").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
2674: 
2675: 
2676: def _mobile_device_valid(token: str) -> bool:
2677:     token=str(token or "").strip()
2678:     if not token: return False
2679:     with _db() as conn:
2680:         row=conn.execute("SELECT active FROM mobile_devices WHERE token_hash=?", (_mobile_device_hash(token),)).fetchone()
2681:         if not row or not int(row["active"] or 0): return False
2682:         conn.execute("UPDATE mobile_devices SET last_seen_at=? WHERE token_hash=?", (_now(),_mobile_device_hash(token)))
2683:     return True
2684: 
2685: 
2686: def _mobile_json_response(data: dict[str, Any], device_token: str = "", clear_cookie: bool = False) -> Response:
2687:     res=Response(_json(data), media_type="application/json")
2688:     if clear_cookie:
2689:         res.delete_cookie("hca_mobile_device", path="/api/hca-shared")
2690:     elif device_token:
2691:         res.set_cookie("hca_mobile_device", device_token, max_age=31536000, httponly=True, secure=True, samesite="strict", path="/api/hca-shared")
2692:     return res
2693: 
2694: 
2695: @router.post("/mobile/pairing/create", dependencies=auth)
2696: async def mobile_pairing_create() -> dict[str, Any]:
2697:     _cleanup_mobile_pairings()
2698:     token = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()
2699:     MOBILE_PAIRINGS[token] = time.time() + MOBILE_PAIRING_TTL_SECONDS
2700:     return {"ok": True, "token": token, "expires_in": MOBILE_PAIRING_TTL_SECONDS}
2701: 
2702: 
2703: @router.post("/mobile")
2704: async def mobile_pairing_redeem(request: Request) -> Response:
2705:     body = await request.json()
2706:     body=body or {}
2707:     action=str(body.get("action") or "").strip().lower()
2708:     pair_token = str(body.get("pair_token") or "").strip().upper()
2709:     supplied_device = str(body.get("device_token") or "").strip()
2710:     cookie_device = str(request.cookies.get("hca_mobile_device") or "").strip()
2711:     device_token=supplied_device or cookie_device
2712:     _cleanup_mobile_pairings()
2713: 
2714:     if action == "revoke":
2715:         if device_token:
2716:             with _db() as conn:
2717:                 conn.execute("UPDATE mobile_devices SET active=0,last_seen_at=? WHERE token_hash=?", (_now(),_mobile_device_hash(device_token)))
2718:         return _mobile_json_response({"ok":True}, clear_cookie=True)
2719: 
2720:     if pair_token:
2721:         expires_at = MOBILE_PAIRINGS.pop(pair_token, None)
2722:         if not expires_at or expires_at <= time.time():
2723:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Pairing-Code ist ungültig oder abgelaufen.")
2724:         device_token=secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
2725:         now=_now(); ua=str(request.headers.get("user-agent") or "")[:500]
2726:         with _db() as conn:
2727:             conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO mobile_devices(token_hash,label,user_agent,active,created_at,last_seen_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)", (_mobile_device_hash(device_token),"Mobile-Device",ua,1,now,now))
2728:     elif not _mobile_device_valid(device_token):
2729:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Mobile-Device ist nicht verbunden. Bitte erneut per QR-Code koppeln.")
2730: 
2731:     api_key = str(os.getenv("HCA_API_KEY", "") or "").strip()
2732:     if not api_key:
2733:         raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="HCA API-Schlüssel ist am Server nicht konfiguriert.")
2734:     # API-Key wird nur für diese Browser-Sitzung zurückgegeben und nicht dauerhaft im Mobile-Device gespeichert.
2735:     return _mobile_json_response({"ok": True, "api_key": api_key, "device_token": device_token if pair_token else ""}, device_token=device_token)
2736:

4339:         label="Einnahmen-/Verkaufskategorie" if direction=="customer" else "Ausgabenkategorie"
4340:         raise RuntimeError(f"Bitte in den Lexware-Einstellungen zuerst eine {label} auswählen.")
4341:     grouped: dict[float,dict[str,float]]={}
4342:     if direction=="supplier":
4343:         rate=float(row["tax_rate"] or 19); grouped[rate]={"gross":float(row["total_gross"] or 0),"tax":float(row["total_tax"] or 0)}
4344:     else:

4346:             rate=float(item["tax_rate"] or 0); g=grouped.setdefault(rate,{"gross":0.0,"tax":0.0}); g["gross"]+=float(item["gross_total"] or 0); g["tax"]+=float(item["tax_total"] or 0)
4347:         if not grouped:

4349:     voucher_items=[{"amount":round(v["gross"],2),"taxAmount":round(v["tax"],2),"taxRatePercent":rate,"categoryId":category_id} for rate,v in grouped.items()]

5623:     return {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k not in {"imap_password","smtp_password"}} | {"password_set":bool(a.get("imap_password") or a.get("smtp_password"))}

5626: def _decode_mail_header(value: str) -> str:
5627:     parts=[]
5628:     for raw, charset in decode_header(value or ""):
5629:         parts.append(raw.decode(charset or "utf-8","replace") if isinstance(raw,bytes) else str(raw))
5630:     return "".join(parts)

5633: def _imap_connect(account: dict[str, Any]):
5634:     host=str(account.get("imap_host") or ""); port=int(account.get("imap_port") or 993)
5635:     if not host: raise RuntimeError("IMAP-Server fehlt.")
5636:     client=imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(host,port,timeout=30) if str(account.get("imap_security") or "ssl")=="ssl" else imaplib.IMAP4(host,port,timeout=30)
5637:     if str(account.get("imap_security") or "ssl")=="starttls": client.starttls()
5638:     client.login(str(account.get("username") or account.get("email") or ""),str(account.get("imap_password") or "")); return client
